title: Retrospective Analyses of the Greenbrook Database Evaluating Mental Health Treatments
official: Retrospective Analyses of the Greenbrook Database Evaluating Mental Health Treatments
summary: The study involves multiple retrospective analyses to understand the utilization of mental health treatments provided at Greenbrook and their effectiveness
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female reported in database and not an invalid entry
* Age reported and not an invalid entry
* Treatment date in 2011 or later.

Exclusion Criteria:

• Incomplete information on treatment parameters
